notes: Printer Bot 3.3.0-beta.1 is a prerelease with a print queue. A receipt that its printer cannot take right now (off, unplugged, offline, out of paper, not found, held back by a stuck job, a sticker printer asleep) no longer fails: it waits on this PC, for as long as it takes, and prints when the printer is back, in the order the receipts came, also after a restart. Printer Bot checks with Windows that each receipt printed, and one that left the Windows queue unprinted prints again. Under each printer the dock says what waits and why, with Show the receipts, Discard, Discard all, Move and Try again; under Advanced you choose what happens to the receipts of a printer you change. Waiting receipts are kept encrypted and deleted once printed. Dock test prints never wait. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart.
